note: Machine validation binds final business canonical JSON, exact site/target/operation, runtime scope and source bytes. Supported remote scope: product create/update and article create/update; article create additionally requires current-deployment ISS-111 qualification evidence before the draft request. It does not prove reviewer identity or real independence. Optional update-only content passthrough (ISS-131 option b): add content_passthrough=true plus content_passthrough_ref{ref,digest} pointing at an artifact {object_type,target_id,content} inside the runtime scope (sha256 of file bytes) and a WARN/accepted_warn finding at location 'content'; the Slate shape walk is then skipped for content (presence/non-empty and all other checks still apply) and the mutation wrapper fresh-reverifies the live content snapshot before transport.
